title: Conditional Optimal Transport and Triangular Maps for Imitation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.19815v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce a unified formulation of imitation learning from demonstrations as a conditional sampling problem solved by triangular transport: a policy is the second block of a triangular map that transports a reference distribution to the conditional distribution of the action chunk given the observation history. Unlike in Diffusion Policy, where it is a fixed Gaussian, the reference becomes a design variable; we take it to be the empirical distribution of the demonstrated action chunks and introduce three instances of the formulation: an optimal transport policy (OTP), a flow matching policy (FMP), and a stochastic interpolant policy (SIP). translated_title: 条件最优传输与三角映射用于模仿学习
translated_abstract: 我们将基于演示的模仿学习统一表述为一个条件采样问题，并通过三角传输来求解：策略是三角映射的第二个分块，该映射将一个参考分布传输到给定观测历史条件下动作块（action chunk）的条件分布。与Diffusion Policy中参考分布是固定高斯分布不同，这里的参考分布成为一个可设计的变量；我们将其取为演示动作块的经验分布，并提出了该框架的三个实例：最优传输策略（OTP）、流匹配策略（FMP）和随机插值策略（SIP）。在Push-T和robomimic Square任务上，这三种策略在任务性能上可与Diffusion Policy和Consistency Policy相媲美，同时使用的网络规模明显更小、训练时间更短，且在演示数据较少时，信息丰富的参考分布对其性能贡献了相当大的部分。
tldr: 该论文提出将模仿学习统一表述为可通过三角传输求解的条件采样问题，以演示动作块的经验分布作为可设计的参考分布，构建了最优传输策略（OTP）、流匹配策略（FMP）和随机插值策略（SIP）三种实例，在任务性能与Diffusion Policy相当的同时显著减小了网络规模并缩短了训练时间。
en_tdlr: This paper unifies imitation learning as a conditional sampling problem solved by triangular transport, treating the empirical distribution of demonstrated action chunks as a designable reference distribution, and introduces three instances (OTP, FMP, SIP) that match Diffusion Policy's performance while using considerably smaller networks and shorter training.
